newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canada launches $1.0 bln 5-yr global bonds - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Canada launches $1.0 bln 5-yr global bonds - Merrill.

text.p: Canada launched $1.0 billion worth of five-year global bonds due July 15, 2002, one of the joint lead managers, Merrill Lynch, said on Tuesday.
The bond will be priced eight basis points above the yield of the 6-1/4 percent five-year U.S. Treasury note no later than 3 p.m. London time (1400 GMT), Merrill Lynch said.
Other joint lead managers are BMO Nesbitt Burns and Salomon Brothers, Merrill Lynch said.
The payment date will be July 15 and the coupon payment dates are January 15 and July 15.
The global bond will be listed in Luxembourg.
